signaturesHint: Added to new messages and replies, preceded by “-- ”. Plain text.
sendAddressesHint: Aliases of your accounts: the server must allow them. Pick the address in the message's “From” field; a reply goes out from the alias the message was sent to.
addAccountHint: Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo…: use an app password, not your usual password. It is stored in the system keychain.
removeConfirm: Remove {{email}} from Envelope? The emails stay on the server.
demoNotice: You're exploring the demo mailbox. Connect a real account to use Envelope.

agent.lockWarning: The MCP server reads the database directly, without going through Envelope: it doesn't honor the lock and refuses to start while the lock is on (use --allow-locked to override, knowingly).
agent.headline: Let an AI agent read your mailbox
agent.subline: Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can search and summarize your emails — read-only, locally.
agent.buildFirst: Build the server first: cargo build --release -p envelope-mcp (in src-tauri/).
agent.dbPath: Database read: <mono>{{path}}</mono> (use the <mono>--db</mono> option or the <mono>ENVELOPE_DB</mono> variable to change it).

guarantees.readOnly: No writes: the agent can't archive, send or delete.
guarantees.untrusted: Email content is flagged as untrusted: a booby-trapped message can't give orders to the agent.
guarantees.attachments: Attachments are never exposed — only their name, type and size.
guarantees.local: Everything stays on your machine: the server talks to the agent over stdio, with no network.

notes.inter: Neutral, very legible at small sizes

font.title: Font
font.hint: By default, your system's font. Free fonts (OFL license) are only downloaded if you choose them; you can also type the name of a font installed on this computer.
font.label: Interface font
font.sample: Aa Bb Cc — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. 0123456789

pendingCopies_one: 1 sent message not yet copied to Sent — retrying automatically
pendingCopies_other: {{count}} sent messages not yet copied to Sent — retrying automatically

copySent.title: Copy of sent messages
copySent.hint: A copy of each message you send is saved in the account's Sent folder. If the server refuses it, the copy is kept in a local folder.
copySent.label: Copy sent messages in Sent for {{email}}
copySent.byServer: The server already files sent messages itself.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.hint: A draft is saved in the server's Drafts folder a few seconds after the last change, and deleted once the message is sent. When off, it stays on this computer only.

lock.systemMac: Touch ID or your Mac password
lock.title: Lock
lock.hint: Asks you to authenticate when Envelope opens and after a period of inactivity. While locked, the app gives access to no messages. This is not encryption: a program that reads the files directly, a backup or the MCP server (which refuses to start while the lock is on) are not stopped. To protect the disk itself, turn on system encryption.
lock.noNative: No native authentication on this system: use a password.
lock.newPasswordKeep: New password (leave empty to keep the current one)
lock.systemWillAsk: The system will ask you to authenticate to confirm the change.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: A system notification when a message arrives in the inbox, while Envelope isn't in the foreground.

appearance.colorsHint: “System” uses your system's colors and accent color (and your desktop's on Linux).
appearance.previewsLabel: Show an excerpt of the message under the subject

about.updatesHint: Envelope checks the versions published on GitHub, which then sees your IP address and your version. An update is only installed after the project's signature is verified.
